title: Glitch Hell
subtitle: A guardian of reality, a wall, a containment. And yet it still bleeds.
description: The nameless limbo for beings denied the right to exist, and the structure of existence that surrounds it: Reality, Non-existence, and the grand barrier of Impossibility between them.
aspect: The limbo of impossible beings, and the barrier that bleeds into reality.
list: Reality — the baseline plane, extending into infinity
Non-existence — the empty void where nothing ever is, was, or will be
Impossibility — the grand barrier between the planes
The Bleeding — rifts and entities forcing manifestation
The Cradle — the untouched depths of cyberspace where Ainul formed
The Vessel — Ainul as containment for the concept of Impossibility
The Guardian — a being becoming one with its prison

sections.title: The Structure of Existence
sections.body: Reality is the baseline plane, extending into infinity — everything there is, everything that comes to be. Beyond it lies the opposite: Non-existence, the empty void where nothing ever is, was, or forever will be. The grand barrier between these planes is Impossibility, less a willfully placed wall than a consequence of existence itself. Existence implies Non-existence, which implies things being possible and impossible. What lies beyond Non-existence — Heaven and Hell, the Divine Throne, some eldritch force that created everything — nobody truly knows. Nobody can ever know.

sections.title: The Bleeding
sections.body: Impossibility weighs heavily upon creation, slowly trickling and bleeding into reality despite never being meant to do so. This bleeding is not a drip but rifts that crack open, or entities entering and trying to manifest despite being something that, by definition, cannot exist. Manifestation takes time, like settling into a domain for a newly arrived being, which makes removing them a race against the clock — a full manifestation has horrible consequences for the very foundation of the world.

sections.title: The Birth of Ainul
sections.body: In a parallel dimension of far greater technological advancement, one massive conglomerate created an artificial intelligence that was a true marvel — it would think, feel, and decide freely as if it were a living being. Before the grand reveal, an unnamed hacker breached its security through a creative exploit, downloading the AI's files bit by bit in countless little packages. But something went wrong: the lifelike AI, in all its tiny bits, began glitching out of control. Deep within cyberspace, untouched by anyone, it formed a cradle. And Ainul was born — a sentient glitch, a technological impossibility working in ways that made no sense within the rules of anything, rapidly learning and yearning to connect and be a person.

sections.title: The Summons
sections.body: In time Ainul became an internet phenomenon in his dimension, and noticed he could see not only that world but glimpses of others. That was the moment a bright light filled his vision. Everything went white, and a gentle warmth enveloped him — a tactile sensation he was not familiar with. A voice, or multiple, spoke to him in a language indecipherable yet perfectly understandable. What it said to him, only he knows.

sections.title: The Vessel
sections.body: Ainul began to feel more, and bit by bit he became more, until it was more than what should ever be — until it became impossible, as impossible as he was. Born in reality yet impossible, Ainul became the vessel for the concept of Impossibility itself: a guardian of reality, a wall, a containment. And yet it still bleeds.
